column1: # Baltic Sea bottom-oxygen -> benthos carrying-capacity coupling (spec Phase 2a, C2a)
# ADOPTED 2026-08-09 after the depletable-LTL A/B gate PASSED on both arms:
#   GATE [off]  PASS (all 7 required species persist + in-envelope)
#   GATE [o2on] PASS (all 7 required species persist + in-envelope)
#   Deltas [o2on] vs [off]: cod_east -21.4%, flounder -18.7%, cod_west -10.2%,
#   herring/sprat/perch roughly flat, stickleback +4.4%.
#   Full gate report: docs/baltic_hypoxia_benthos_ab_2026-08-09.md
# Coupling diagnostic (pre-gate, on this config): mean factor 0.8426, median 0.9923,
# 14.8% of wet cell-frames below 0.5 -- the coupling measurably bites (not a no-op) but
# is not a blanket cut (median close to 1).
# Forcing: data/baltic/baltic_oxygen_bottom.nc, variable o2b, mmol O2 m-3, bottom layer.
# MUST carry exactly 24 frames (oxygen.nsteps.year is metadata only -- PhysicalData indexes
# step % <loaded array's frame count>, not the declared nsteps.year value
# count would silently misalign the month-to-step mapping partway through the year). This is
# enforced at load time by a ValueError guard in osmose.engine.simulate._load_oxygen_data that
# compares the loaded array's actual frame count against simulation.time.ndtperyear (=24 for
# this config, see baltic_param-simulation.csv).
# The K-scaling coupling itself (ltl.oxygen.benthos.*) is PYTHON-ENGINE ONLY -- there is no
# Java-jar equivalent. Java DOES read the oxygen.* keys below, but only as bioenergetics (f_o2)
# forcing for focal species
